title: Wire MHT-CET predictor form to backend predictor call and typed results rendering

requirements.summary: Update MhtCetPredictorFormPage to call the backend predictor via useActor and render loading, success (estimated rank + table), and error states without page reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the form performs a backend call instead of only `console.log`.
The page shows a loading state on submit (e.g., disable the submit button and/or show loading text) until the backend responds.
On success, the UI renders a results section containing a table with columns: College, Branch, Chance, and rows matching the backend dummy data.
The UI also displays the returned `estimatedRank` value near the results (English user-facing text).
On backend error, the UI displays an English error message without crashing and allows retrying submission.
No full page reload occurs on submit (still `preventDefault`).

file_operations.description: Use the core-infrastructure `useActor` hook to call the backend predictor method on submit, replacing the current console.log handler. Add local UI state for loading, error, and results; disable the submit button and/or show loading text while awaiting the response; render the returned estimated rank in English and a results table (College/Branch/Chance) using composed shadcn-ui primitives already imported (Card/Button/etc.) without editing `frontend/src/components/ui`. Ensure submission remains SPA-safe with preventDefault and supports retry after errors. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the frontend backend bindings/types so the actor interface includes the new predictor method and strongly-typed response payload used by the form page.
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript compilation succeeds with no missing-method/type errors for the new backend call.
The actor type (`backendInterface`) includes the predictor method with correct argument and return types matching the Motoko canister interface.
The frontend code calls the backend method without any `any`-typed escape hatches for the response payload.

file_operations.description: Extend the generated backend TypeScript declarations to include the new predictor method signature and response types (including `estimatedRank` and an array of `{ college, branch, chance }` predictions). Keep types fully explicit so the page can call the method without `any`, and represent backend errors in the type (Result-style variant) if the canister interface uses it. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
